newsitem.title: USA: Boyds Wheel sees Q2 net loss about $1.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Boyds Wheel sees Q2 net loss about $1.1 mln.

text.p: Boyds Wheel Inc said Friday it expects to report a second quarter loss of about $1.1 million.
The company said the anticipated loss is attributable to continued lower than expected sales and increased overhead due to recent facilities expansion.

"We are obviously disappointed with the anticipated results of the continued softness of our sales during a quarter which has historically been one of our best; in response we have instituted further reductions in overhead to address this immediate situation," chief executive officer Boyd Coddington said in a release.

"The second and third quarters industry-wide typically post the strongest results," Coddington said, "and, looking ahead, we remain excited about a number of our new product lines, specifically several new styles of painted and chromed cast wheels, targeting the growing demand for these finishes in the lower price-point categories."
